address.streetAddress: 1941 south military trail, 16-B, West Palm Beach, 33415

reviews.author: Rafael U…
reviews.body:
Mari is amazing at getting rid of pain. I started having a sharp pain in my knee that got so bad I was limping, and because of some test results I had gotten from my doctor, I convinced myself it might be something serious like rheumatism lol. I booked a session with Mari, and the same day I walked out feeling completely normal. The massage definitely hurts a little while she works on it, but it’s 100% worth it. The knee pain never came back.
More recently, I forgot to warm up before working out and ended up with terrible pain in my upper back/shoulder area. Within a few days I could barely sleep. I called Mari, and in just 30 minutes she had me feeling normal again. I was a little sore after the session, but now I’m back to moving pain-free 💯

reviews.author: Brentton F…
reviews.body: Another great session! My deep tissue massage and breath work session was so much better than I expected. I was honestly surprised by how powerful the breath work was. She was calm, kind, and made me feel completely comfortable the whole time. I left feeling incredible and can’t wait to book with her again.

reviews.author: Brentton F…
reviews.body:
Mari was absolutely exceptional. My sports massage and cupping therapy experience exceeded every expectation I had. She is not only incredibly skilled and knowledgeable in her craft, but also a phenomenal spirit to work with. From the moment the session began, Mari created an environment that felt safe, comfortable, and deeply professional, which made all the difference in such an intimate setting.

Mari is the kind of professional you immediately trust: not just because of her talent, but because of the quality of person she is. Warm, professional, intuitive, and genuinely caring, she brings a presence that enhances the entire experience. I left feeling restored, cared for, and genuinely grateful. I cannot recommend her highly enough.
